targets: pimcore is a web - based application and employs the php programming language and the mysql / mariadb relational database management system . pimcore ’ s component based core architecture can be described as a best of breed use of the zend framework , the symfony project and leading php architectural patterns and components such as composer . pimcore applies the conventions of object - oriented programming , model – view – controller architecture and the latest php programming paradigms like namespaces and traits . pimcore strictly adheres to php coding standards and follows the rules and recommendations of the php framework interop group ( psr 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 & 7 ) . since the first pimcore release in 2010 pimcore has followed a strict api driven approach , by offering both a php based core api and open restful apis for all available functionalities and integrations to 3rd party applications . the core of pimcore is extensible through extensions , content components and applications utilizing the apis . pimcore includes an administrative backend interface for managing data and system configuration . the whole interface is powered by the sencha extjs 6 framework providing the graphical user interface for pimcore .

pimcore officially started development in 2009 . on january 21 , 2010 the first public beta version was released . the elements group , owning pimcore , decided to provide pimcore as open source for free use . in june 2013 pimcore became a dedicated subsidiary of the elements group , pimcore gmbh , that cares about the strategy , roadmap , core development of pimcore and provides value added services like consulting , training and implementation . starting 2015 pimcore launched a global partnership program with system integrators and digital agencies and has now subsidiaries with exclusive partners in several countries in europe , north america and southeast asia .

pimcore ’ s product is a portfolio focused on multi - domain master data management , omni - channel e - commerce and user experience management . the whole software platform composed of product information management ( pim ) , web content management ( cms ) , digital asset management ( dam ) and e - commerce is dual - licensed and available under the free and open - source gplv3 and the proprietary pel ( pimcore enterprise ) licenses . pimcore is currently ( may 2016 ) used more than 80 . 000 times in 174 different countries and has been translated to 18 different languages .

generation.history:
History

The history of Pimcore can be traced back to the need for effective management and distribution of product information for companies with large product bases. Major well-known companies have employed Pimcore's MDM/PIM products to enhance their digital presence and easily disseminate product information to their stores and partners worldwide. One such example is Gant, an international clothing company that utilized Pimcore's solutions to achieve its digital goals. 

Pimcore's flexibility and usability have been demonstrated in complex undertakings. For instance, Pimcore was instrumental in building an e-commerce portal for a telecommunications giant in Southeast Asia, integrating with multiple legacy backend systems. The Pimcore system's adaptability and ease of use enabled the delivery of a fully functioning e-commerce site with reduced resources and time compared to competing efforts.

### Operations

Versalogic Corp. is a US-based embedded computer company that delivers state-of-the-art embedded computers and technical support for critical long-life markets, including the medical and defense industries. The company is committed to product quality and process control, offering customization options such as conformal coating, revision locks, custom labeling, and enhanced testing and screening. Versalogic has built a reputation for highly reliable products and superior service, with a focus on memory module issues and rigorous testing procedures. The company strives to create a positive work environment and communicate the reasoning behind its practices. 

Versalogic's operations include a partnership with CMTL, which allows for reduced development cycles and a wider range of certified memory options for its customers. The company's Viper product is a rugged single-board computer with extensive I/O capabilities, low power consumption, and fanless operation over a wide temperature range. Versalogic also offers power systems with various configurations and socket types, making them suitable for multiple applications.
generation.history:
### History

Versalogic Corp. is a US-based embedded computer company with a 40-year history in the industry. The company has built its reputation on providing highly reliable products and superior service. Versalogic is known for its commitment to product quality and process control, delivering state-of-the-art embedded computers coupled with expert technical support. Their products are designed for critical long-life markets, such as the medical and defense industries, where reliability and consistency are paramount. The company has a strong focus on memory module issues and has completed over 25,000 memory product functionality and compatibility tests to date. 

Versalogic's longevity and consistency have earned it the trust of its customers, with a reputation as the industry's most trusted embedded computer company. Their product life extension programs further reinforce this trust by keeping each technology generation available for an extended period, typically over a decade. The company's dedication to improvement and creating a positive work environment has contributed to its success and longevity in the highly competitive technology sector.
